focus: sensitivity of the example drift guard and the card sync guard

findingDetails.title: Both new guards depend on rg without a preflight or declaration, and the drift guard prints EXAMPLE_DRIFT_OK on a drifted tree when rg is absent
findingDetails.impact: Three criteria in this packet read that single success string, and it is reachable without the anchor comparison having run.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Add a command -v rg preflight that exits non-zero, or replace rg with grep so the guard has no undeclared dependency.

findingDetails.title: Card sync checks its fourth surface only negatively, so a checklist that names no example passes
findingDetails.impact: A reader can lose every pointer to the card and the guard still reports CARD SYNC OK.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Assert positively that the checklist names the card and at least one filled example.

findingDetails.title: The drift guard has no coverage floor over the example tree, so an empty level directory fails with a misleading description message
findingDetails.impact: A renamed or emptied example directory is reported as a description defect plus an awk error rather than as a missing example.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Count the examples found and fail with a named message when a level directory holds none.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Two shipped guards probed by mutation, empty-input and missing-dependency runs against copies of the real example tree

targetSelection.selectionReason: Both guards are named as gates by three criteria in the packet, so their sensitivity is the claim under review
